== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Sel’miroth was a prominent member of the [[D’Niss]] and one of the [[Seven Calamities]], though she was noted as being the smallest among that group. A powerful psychic and hypnotist, she viewed herself as a primary follower of [[Esh’kinaar]] due to the nuanced nature of her mental powers. She commanded a massive swarm of soldiers and utilized weapons made of condensed [[Aether]] that traveled through space at near-light speeds. Despite her status as a major threat capable of breaking mental defenses, she eventually became the sole survivor of the [[Seven Calamities]]. Her end came after being struck by a high-level [[Aethertech weapon]] known as [[Worldslayer]], which caused her body to rapidly wither. In her final moments, she attempted to cast a taxing spell and died in a state of triumph upon the arrival of her mother.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|This individual possesses shredded rainbow wings. They are recognized as a great [[D’Niss]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Sel’miroth is a hypnotist and a subtle spellcaster.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|As a great [[D’Niss]] and one of the [[Seven Calamities]], Sel’miroth functioned as a subtle hypnotist and spellcaster. During the conflict, the entity was targeted by Sola Kalter{{!}}Sola, who utilized the [[Worldslayer]] beam to pierce its form. Although Sel’miroth was a system subject to a [[Subspace]] blockade, it eventually became the lone survivor of the [[Seven Calamities]]. The entity's life ended when the [[World Spirit of Visiria]] killed it, leaving behind only shredded rainbow wings.}}
